latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Degrees north of the equator, negative to the south

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Degrees east of the prime meridian, negative to the west

thresholds.title: Threshold Sensors
thresholds.description: Sensors that each switch on as the light outdoors reaches one level and off only once it passes another, holding their state across the gap between the two

name.title: Name
name.description: The name the sensor takes in the Home app, where a new name adds a new sensor in place of the old one. It is at least two characters long, starts and ends on a letter or a number, and holds only letters, numbers, spaces, apostrophes, and & ! . _ : ; ( ) / , -

onLux.title: On Level
onLux.description: The reading in lux at which the sensor switches on. A level below the off level switches it on as the light falls, and one above it as the light rises

offLux.title: Off Level
offLux.description: The reading in lux past which the sensor switches off
